notes.2026-11-18: Surprise! You'll get a fresh bouquet in here every single day. Real ones die. These don't, and neither does how I feel about you.
notes.2026-11-19: I am so lucky to have you in my life

backup: Just thinking about you. That's the whole note.
You make ordinary days feel like something worth remembering.
Hope today is as good to you as you are to me.
Pink, white and red, because I couldn't pick just one. Kind of like reasons I like you.
Drink some water, take a breath, and know someone's crazy about you.
